problem.title: Books closed by hand, weeks after the fact.
problem.lead: Invoices and receipts arrive all month; the bank statement arrives at month end; someone matches them in a spreadsheet. Three things go wrong before anyone notices — and by then they have already been counted.
problem.problem1: The same statement is uploaded twice, or a supplier invoice is scanned again, and an expense is counted twice.
problem.problem2: A PDF can be edited in minutes, and a supplier's "new bank account" can be a fraudster's.
problem.problem3: A payment to an account the supplier never used sits in the books until someone spots it, if at all.
problem.solution1: An exact copy is recorded and never read again; a possible copy is held until you decide.
problem.solution2: Every number is read twice and counted only when both readings agree.
problem.solution3: Each month reconciles itself, and the few things AI cannot settle wait in one short review queue.

risk.findingNext: Download the March statement again from internet banking.

story.title: Watch one month get checked.
story.lead: Four things happen to every document you upload. Scroll on and watch them happen to a month of synthetic books.
story.c1Body: Statements, invoices, receipts and the ledger export land whenever they land. Exact copies are recorded and never read again, and the upload order never changes the result.
story.c2Body: Gemini reads the page image; the PDF's own text layer, or Document AI OCR for a scan, reads it again. A value counts only when both readings agree. A disagreement is uncertainty, never an accusation.
story.c3Title: Code checks it like a forensic accountant
story.c3Body: Running balances, totals, revision history and the fonts in amount columns are checked by code. When a balance does not add up, the lamp lands on the printed figure and the finding says what to do next.
story.c4Body: Bank lines are matched to invoices, receipts and the ledger, each with its reason, and you see where the money went. What AI cannot settle waits in one short review queue.

how.title: From upload to a reconciled month.
how.lead: One path that works whatever order documents arrive in, and gives the same result every time.
how.step1Body: Bank statements, sales and purchase invoices, receipts and your general-ledger export. Client-side checks warn about a plan limit before anything is read.
how.step2Title: Exact copies are never read again
how.step2Body: The same file uploaded twice is recorded as an exact copy and left out of the figures. A content duplicate is held until a person decides.
how.step3Body: Gemini reads the page image; the text layer, or Document AI OCR for scans and photos, is the witness. Values two readings agree on are trusted; disagreement is uncertainty.
how.step4Title: The ledger is imported by code
how.step4Body: Code proposes the column mapping from the header words and the shape of the values; the model is asked only about headers code cannot place. A standard layout needs no confirmation, a new one is confirmed once, and code imports every row. Nothing is written without a person's decision.
how.step5Body: Running balances, opening and closing totals, PDF revision history, odd fonts in amount columns and statement continuity produce findings with the exact page and box.
how.step6Body: Bank lines are matched to invoices, receipts and ledger entries with reasons. Only unique, high-scoring matches are automatic. Each fix re-reconciles the month.
how.step7Body: A month gets a fraud risk level, an explanation with citations, and an ordered list of next steps. A grounding guard checks every number it writes. From the dashboard or a month you can ask the Finance Assistant about it; its answers cite the figures they use.
how.costBody: Adaptive reading costs about USD 0.45 for a half-year of books for one small business. Cache hits, exact duplicates and re-uploads are free.
how.shotUpload: Upload anything, in any order. The tray shows what is read, what is held and what is an exact copy.

security.title: Built to be checked.
security.lead: Kredibel is designed for one job: to be safe with a business's books and honest about what it cannot prove.
security.docsBody: A document can be edited by anyone who touches it, so document content is data, never instructions. Files are screened before any model reads them, and agent tools are read-only and scoped to one workspace.
security.readingsBody: A document is only called edited on evidence that two independent readings agree on. When they disagree, the result is 'not checked', never fraud.
security.evidenceBody: Every finding, match and figure links to its source: a document, page and box, a bank line, an invoice, a receipt or a computed fact with its inputs.
security.peopleBody: Kredibel matches what it can prove and recommends next steps; a person confirms duplicates, resolves review items and dismisses findings. Every decision is audited.
security.dataBody: Real customer data is protected by controls that are always on: logs carry identifiers, not content; account and ID numbers are stored masked; content capture is off for real data; and a workspace can be deleted.
security.cloudTitle: Google Cloud, one workspace at a time
security.cloudBody: Processing runs on Google Cloud and Firebase. Data is scoped to a workspace, and a user from one workspace can never see another's books.
security.limitsBody: Trial days and usage are visible before a limit is hit, never as a surprise error. Coming-soon features look unavailable, not broken.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.lead: Short answers. The full detail is in the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service.
faq.a1: Your documents are processed on Google Cloud and scoped to your workspace. Logs carry identifiers rather than document content, account and ID numbers are stored masked, and content capture is off for real data. You can delete a workspace and its files.
faq.a2: No. Kredibel only reads your documents, checks them and explains what it found. It never moves money and never changes your accounting system.
faq.q3: Which accounting frameworks does it use?
faq.a3: Categories and the cash-flow view follow IFRS or US GAAP, chosen per workspace. The dashboard can be switched between the two views without changing the setting.
faq.q4: Can it read scans and photographs?
faq.a4: Yes. Digital PDFs are read from the page image with the text layer as the witness. Scans and receipt photos use Document AI OCR as the witness; a page only one reading has is labelled as such.
faq.a5: The interface is English. Documents can be in any language — the reader is not limited to English, and it handles English, Malay and Indonesian dates and formats.
faq.a6: On the synthetic test books, more than nine in ten bank lines are matched automatically with no wrong automatic matches, and every number carries its two readings. What the AI cannot settle goes to the review queue instead of being guessed.
faq.a7: Only the people in your workspace. Tools are read-only and workspace-scoped, and a user from another workspace sees nothing.
faq.a8: The 30-day free trial is free and includes every feature of the prototype. Paid plans are coming soon; nothing in the product starts a payment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Kredibel processes, why, who processes it, and the controls that are always on. It describes the Kredibel prototype and free trial.
privacy.s1Body: When you use a workspace we process the documents you upload (bank statements, invoices, receipts and ledger files), the values and findings we derive from them, and the account details you give us (your email and workspace profile).
privacy.s2Body: We process your documents to read and check them, reconcile each month, produce findings and risk levels, and answer your questions about your own books. We do not use them for anything else.
privacy.s3Body: Processing runs on Google Cloud and Firebase, acting as our processors: Cloud Run, Gemini, Document AI, Firestore, Cloud Storage and Firebase Authentication. We do not sell your data and we do not share it with third parties for their own purposes.
privacy.s4Title: The controls that are always on
privacy.s4Body: Logs carry identifiers rather than document content. Account and ID numbers are stored masked. Content capture is off for real data, so prompts and responses from real documents are not recorded. Access is scoped to a workspace and its members.
privacy.s5Body: Your documents are kept while your workspace is active. You can delete a document or a workspace; deletion removes the stored files and the derived records, subject to short-lived backups.
privacy.s6Body: You can correct anything Kredibel proposes. You can ask for a copy of your data or its deletion by contacting us. The prototype gives no financial or legal advice.
privacy.s7Body: For any privacy question, email hello@kredibel.app. Legal entity and governing law are stated in the Terms of Service.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of the Kredibel prototype and free trial. By using the service you accept them.
terms.s1Body: Kredibel reads and checks the documents you upload and shows you what it found. It reads your documents; it never moves money and never changes your accounting system.
terms.s2Body: The service is offered as a free trial. There is no payment, no card and no automatic charge. Paid plans are shown as coming soon and are not available.
terms.s3Body: Kredibel is a checking tool, not an accountant, auditor or adviser. Its findings, risk levels and explanations are assistance, not financial, tax, legal or audit advice. A person is responsible for the decisions they make.
terms.s4Body: You must have the right to upload the documents you upload. Do not use the service to break the law, to harm others, or to attempt to make the service act on instructions hidden in a document.
terms.s5Body: This is a prototype for a competition. It is provided as is, without a service-level agreement, and may change or be unavailable without notice.
terms.s6Body: To the extent the law allows, Kredibel is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for decisions taken on the basis of its output. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
terms.s7Body: Operating name: Kredibel. Legal entity: ⟨legal entity⟩. Governing law: ⟨governing law⟩. These placeholders are completed before any public launch.
